probe: baseline small workbook
expected: ACCEPTED

probe: Schedule columns re-ordered: Emp ID moved to column 4, TL in column 2
expected: names/languages still bound by header; employee IDs read correctly

probe: Schedule day headers are real dates (not Sun..Sat) and carry fixed requests; no Fixed Request sheet
expected: day columns found or refused; never a positional guess

probe: Preference sheet lists the same associate twice: Leave on Monday, then a blank row
expected: duplicate refused (as Previous-Saturday duplicates are) or Leave kept
parser_notes: PREFERENCE_BLANK_DUPLICATE_IGNORED: 'Agent A' has an empty extra row 4 on the Preference sheet; row 3 is used.

probe: Fixed Request sheet with date headers instead of Sun..Sat (Fixed Request Use = Yes)
expected: fixed requests read, or refused; never silently dropped

probe: 11-hour shifts requested while Use 11H/3OFF = No
expected: refused with a contradiction message; never a silent switch to 9-hour shifts
parser_notes: HARD_LONG_DURATION_WITHOUT_11H_MODE: Allowed Shift Durations lists 11 h but Use 11H/3OFF is No, so those shifts cannot be scheduled. Set Use 11H/3OFF to Yes or remove the long durations.

probe: Interval Minutes = 30 but the demand sheet is 15-minute
expected: refused or demand preserved; never silently drop half the rows
parser_notes: HARD_OFF_GRID_REQUIREMENT_TIME:sheet=FT Wise 30 Min;interval_minutes=30;rows=[36, 38, 40, 42, 44, 46, 48, 50, 52, 54];count=24;these rows carry demand at times that are not on the 30-minute grid and would be ignored

probe: Demand sheet repeats the 10:00 row; the repeat is blank
expected: duplicate time refused; never silently erase demand
parser_notes: HARD_DUPLICATE_REQUIREMENT_TIME:sheet=FT Wise 60 Min;time=10:00;rows=13,14;keep one row per interval

probe: Demand sheet is missing the 12:00 row entirely
expected: warned or refused; never silently read as 'no demand'
parser_notes: HARD_MISSING_REQUIREMENT_TIME:sheet=FT Wise 60 Min;missing=['12:00'];count=1;every interval needs its own row (leave the cells blank for no demand)

probe: No-break exceptions enabled with Max Associate-Days = 0
expected: 0 honoured, or refused as contradictory
parser_notes: HARD_CONTRADICTORY_NO_BREAK_LIMIT: no-break exceptions are enabled but the maximum is 0. Disable the exceptions or give a maximum of 1 or more.

probe: 'Count of Different Shifts Per week' = 'three'; and = 0
expected: refused as non-numeric / out of range

parser_notes: HARD_INVALID_INSTRUCTION_NUMBER:key='Count of Different Shifts Per week';value='three';use a numeric value

probe: Coverage Split row with Start = '9am'
expected: refused; never silently drop a hard staffing rule
parser_notes: HARD_INVALID_COVERAGE_SPLIT_ROW:Coverage Split row 2 Start='9am'; use a time such as 08:00

probe: Language minimum 0.5 and -1
expected: refused (minimum must be a whole number >= 0)

parser_notes: HARD_INVALID_LANGUAGE_MINIMUM:row=3;value=0.5;use a whole number of zero or more
HARD_INVALID_LANGUAGE_MINIMUM:row=3;value=-1;use a whole number of zero or more

probe: One associate on Leave all 7 days (Strict OFF = Yes)
expected: accepted; that associate simply does not work

probe: Shift Library with malformed labels ('9-18', '08:00 - 24:00') beside valid ones
expected: malformed labels reported
parser_notes: HARD_INVALID_SHIFT_LABEL:sheet=Shift Library;row=3;value='08:00 - 24:00';use HH:MM - HH:MM with hours 00-23 (a shift ending at midnight ends at 00:00)

probe: Demand cell 'abc'
expected: REFUSED
parser_notes: HARD_INVALID_REQUIREMENT_VALUE:sheet=FT Wise 60 Min;row=13;day=Mon;value='abc';use a non-negative number

probe: Roster has 25 blank rows between associates 5 and 6; Count of Associates left blank
expected: all 10 associates read, or refused
parser_notes: HARD_ROSTER_ROWS_AFTER_BLANK_GAP: the Schedule sheet has 5 name(s) below a gap of more than 20 empty rows (first: 'Agent F'). Remove the gap so every associate is read.

probe: Previous-Saturday shift '25:00 - 06:00' (invalid hour)
expected: refused
parser_notes: HARD_INVALID_PREVIOUS_SATURDAY_SHIFT: 'Agent A' has '25:00 - 06:00' on the Previous week scheduled sheet; use a shift such as 22:00 - 07:00, OFF, or leave it blank.

probe: Instructions list 'Target' twice: 0.9 then 0.5
expected: refused as contradictory, or warned

probe: Language Working Window = 'Enforce' (not a listed value)
expected: REFUSED

probe: Overnight day-specific language minimum Mon-Fri 18:00-05:00 (Spanish, min 1)
expected: minimum applies Mon 18:00..Tue 05:00 ... Fri 18:00..Sat 05:00; NOT Mon 00:00-05:00
